_comment: Delegation chain for the reporting-agent user stories (see docs/stories.md). Dana, an FP&A analyst, delegates to Acme Finance, which issues a narrowed credential to her 'revenue-pack' agent. Each hop only narrows: hop 1 bounds the verbs, hop 2 bounds the exact resources the agent may touch. NON-SECRET demo value: rootKeyHex below is a fixed macaroon root key, committed for reproducibility, never a real credential. Enumerated in SECURITY.md 'Committed demo material'.
